newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still an ING buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still an ING buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian paper and pulp firm Aracruz Celulose SA, but raised its year-end price target for the firm's stock to $26 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) from $23.
-- "Lower pulp stocks and U.S. dollar weakness led us to raise our year-end price target," analyst Paulo Vasconcellos said in a report.
-- He also cited higher pulp prices, adding the second consecutive monthly drop in pulp inventories "gives strength to the new prices."
-- Eucalyptus suppliers in particular are carrying little or no supply of pulp at mills or at European ports, he added.
-- "The current risk we see for the next few months include some slowdown in demand and higher operating rates in response to higher prices," the report said.
-- If that fear is not confirmed, pulp prices could go higher in 1997's second half, Vasconcellos said.

-- He said Aracruz also should benefit from recent weakness in the U.S. dollar versus the Japanese yen and German mark, adding the devaluation should help price rises since the company's exports are dollar-denominated.
-- Aracruz's ADR was up 1/8 at 20-5/8 in New York and its preferred B share was up 0.92 percent at 2.19 reais in Sao Paulo.
